step1.ptxt: When Hands-free Calls Cannot Be Made

step2.ptxt: Hands-free cannot be used to make calls in the following cases.

item.ptxt: When outgoing calls are restricted, such as when lines are congested
During an HELPNET emergency call, automatic maintenance check or manual maintenance check
When phonebook data is being transferred from the phone
When the phone is in use, such as during data communication
When the phone is not connected
When the phone battery charge is insufficient
When the phone power is OFF
While using i-mode, Vodafone live! or EZweb
When the Bluetooth setting of the cellular phone is not in hands-free mode
When the phone itself cannot be used for other reasons

step2.ptxt: If call waiting or three-way calling is subscribed to, cancel call waiting or three-way calling on the phone itself before use.

When HELPNET is used, hands-free cannot be used while HELPNET is operating. Also, while HELPNET is operating, the line cannot be disconnected by hanging up. Hands-free calls can be made while waiting for automatic incoming calls.
